title: Specify a useful control panel
brief: Configure a panel that distinguishes maximum elevator capacity from the commanded fraction.
supplied: Does a half command apply half of the declared available moment?
Available and applied moment in N m.
Quasi-steady supplied coefficients. Change only the declared independent quantity; other inputs remain fixed.
Linear command mapping is a teaching approximation, not validated elevator aerodynamics.
A half command applies 2000 N m even though capacity remains 4000 N m.

Supplied executable experiment recipe:
For each u in [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1]:
  configured output = u*available
  comparison = available
Return the paired values with the declared units.

The app uses the arithmetic evaluator in src/core/onboarding/expression.js. It supports +, -, *, /, ^ and parentheses; it never evaluates an equation as JavaScript.
Keep capacity and applied command distinct.

fields.label: Displayed applied moment at half command (N m)

checks.message: Only the commanded fraction is applied.
Do not label maximum capacity as the current applied moment.

hints: The command fraction changes applied moment, not the actuator’s full capacity.
Half command means u=0.5; use the supplied capacity.
Half of 4000 N m is 2000 N m. The permitted command range ends at one.
